distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) directly confirms Taiwan occurrence with examined material from Nantou, Taichung and Taipei localities.

host_note: Cinnamomum camphora is explicitly reported as a camphor-log host and is promoted at species level. No broader host inference is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiophilus satoi (Schedl, 1966).

taxonomic_history.name: Ambrosiophilus satoi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treats the species in Ambrosiophilus as a new combination; this nomenclatural provenance is preserved.
